materiality.rationale: REDAgentBench uses isolated service sandboxes and state- or receipt-grounded verification for executable red teaming, covering 1,661 cases across five service surfaces; it matters because it makes agent security evaluation executable and auditable beyond outcome-only tests.

profile_annotations.why_this_issue: This candidate gives the issue a concrete measurement infrastructure for agent risk: isolated services and receipt-grounded checks make it possible to distinguish a claimed action from a verified system effect.
